WITH per_lot AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    date_trunc('month', MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='Inoculated')) AS inoc_month,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='Contaminated') AS contam_at
  FROM public.vc_events
  GROUP BY lot_id
)
SELECT
  inoc_month AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS inoculated_lots,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL) AS contaminated_lots,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric,0),
    4
  ) AS contamination_rate
FROM per_lot
WHERE inoc_month IS NOT NULL
  AND inoc_month >= {{ dpStart.selectedDate }}::timestamp
  AND inoc_month <  {{ dpEnd.selectedDate }}::timestamp
GROUP BY inoc_month
ORDER BY inoc_month;

WITH per_lot AS (

    lot_id,
    date_trunc('month', MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='Inoculated')) AS inoc_month,
    MIN(event_time_for_rollup) FILTER (WHERE type='Contaminated') AS contam_at
  FROM public.vc_events
  GROUP BY lot_id
)
SELECT
  inoc_month AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS inoculated_lots,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL) AS contaminated_lots,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric,0),
    4
  ) AS contamination_rate
FROM per_lot
WHERE inoc_month IS NOT NULL
  AND inoc_month >= {{ dpStart.selectedDate }}::timestamp
  AND inoc_month <  {{ dpEnd.selectedDate }}::timestamp
GROUP BY inoc_month
ORDER BY inoc_month;

WITH e AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    type,
    event_time_for_rollup AS t,
    NULLIF(fields_json,'')::jsonb AS fj
  FROM public.vc_events
  WHERE lot_id = {{ appsmith.store.selectedLotId }}
),
marks AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Inoculated')      AS inoculated_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'FullyColonized')  AS fully_colonized_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'SpawnedToBulk')   AS spawned_to_bulk_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'FruitingStart')   AS fruiting_start_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Contaminated')    AS contaminated_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type IN ('Composted','Consumed','Destroyed')) AS end_of_life_at,

    SUM( (fj->>'harvest_weight_g')::numeric )
      FILTER (WHERE type = 'Harvest' AND (fj ? 'harvest_weight_g')) AS total_harvest_g,

    SUM( (fj->>'harvest_weight_g')::numeric )
      FILTER (WHERE type = 'Harvest' AND (fj->>'flush_no')::int = 1 AND (fj ? 'harvest_weight_g')) AS first_flush_g
  FROM e
  GROUP BY lot_id
)
SELECT
  lot_id,
  inoculated_at,
  fully_colonized_at,
  fruiting_start_at,
  contaminated_at,
  end_of_life_at,
  total_harvest_g,
  first_flush_g,

  CASE WHEN inoculated_at IS NOT NULL AND fully_colonized_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN (fully_colonized_at - inoculated_at)
  END AS colonization_duration,

  CASE
    WHEN fully_colonized_at IS NOT NULL AND fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN (fruiting_start_at - fully_colonized_at)
    WHEN spawned_to_bulk_at IS NOT NULL AND fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN (fruiting_start_at - spawned_to_bulk_at)
  END AS time_to_fruit_after_bulk
FROM marks;

WITH e AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    type,
    event_time_for_rollup AS t,
    NULLIF(fields_json,'')::jsonb AS fj
  FROM public.vc_events
  WHERE lot_id = {{ appsmith.store.selectedLotId }}
